jordan.K_B1: intrinsic C_partial R4 contributes to F and boundary scalar metric constraints; direct q term vanishes at fixed a_J=1
jordan.K_EH: bulk ADM scalar quadratic form; depends on A_q,B_q,E_q and psi_q
jordan.K_GHY: cancels radial second derivatives and contributes to the endpoint constraint form; separate value unavailable before compensation
jordan.K_constraint: negative/indefinite Schur term after solving lapse and shift
jordan.K_endpoint: moving-boundary response paired with the scalar shift trace
jordan.K_scalar: 2 Z5 integral_0^rhoJ N a^2(partial_q sigma)^2 d rho >=2
jordan.cancellations: EH/GHY/constraint/endpoint pieces are gauge dependent separately
